meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合姿态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做蛋白质-小分子对接或虚拟筛选研究
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on protein-ligand docking or virtual screening

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据蛋白质结构或序列与小分子配体，预测配体的三维结合姿态，并给出每个姿态的置信度分数。
howto.when: 当你要求进行分子对接、虚拟筛选，或给出蛋白质PDB文件/序列和配体SMILES/SDF/MOL2时触发。

say.text: 对这批化合物进行虚拟筛选，输入文件是batch_input.csv。
say.note: Claude会批量处理多个蛋白质-配体对，并分析结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can predict 3D binding poses of small molecule ligands to protein targets from PDB files or sequences plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, and output confidence scores for each pose.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for molecular docking, virtual screening, or provide a protein PDB/sequence and ligand SMILES/SDF/MOL2.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to the protein: protein PDB is 1abc.pdb, ligand SMILES is CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O.
say_en.note: Claude runs single docking and outputs top-ranked poses with confidence.

say_en.text: Run virtual screening on this batch CSV: batch_input.csv.
say_en.note: Claude processes multiple complexes and analyzes results.
